name: Paypercut BNPL for WooCommerce
author: Paypercut Dev

sections.description:
PayPerCut BNPL for WooCommerce lets your customers split their purchases into manageable installments while you get paid up front. The extension integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce checkout and supports both classic and Blocks checkout.

  • Simple onboarding with API keys
  • Admin configuration for fees, logging, and environment (test/live)
  • WooCommerce Blocks integration (Cart & Checkout)
  • Compatible with WooCommerce order workflows and refunds

Requires an active PayPerCut merchant account.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → PayPerCut BNPL and click Manage.
  4. Enter your PayPerCut API credentials and select test or live mode.
  5. Enable the gateway.
sections.faq:
Where do I get API credentials?

From your PayPerCut merchant dashboard. Contact PayPerCut support if you need help.

Does this work with WooCommerce Blocks checkout?

Yes. Blocks integration is included and automatically enabled when WooCommerce Blocks is active.

Which countries and currencies are supported?

Support varies by region; please check with PayPerCut for the latest availability.
